body.purpose: Interface labels, controls, and explanatory text.

measurement.purpose: Timings, deltas, sectors, and trace metadata.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button and compact control state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--bg); font: 600 13px/1.2 Barlow, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e2ff81; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet outlined action beside a primary control.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #424b3e; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: 600 13px/1.2 Barlow, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--raised); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Telemetry Panel
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--text); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 24px/1.2 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.5 Barlow, sans-serif; }

components.name: Telemetry Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; color: var(--muted); font: 600 10px/1.2 Barlow, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-input { min-height: 43px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #414d39; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 400 14px/1.5 Barlow, sans-serif; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9aa88e; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 13px 12px; border-radius: 5px; color: #a5afa1; font: 500 14px/1.2 Barlow, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #232922; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #d5f55a12; color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Current Ghost Trace
components.description: Signature current and ghost comparison cue.
components.css: .ds-trace { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 24px; color: var(--accent); font: 400 11px/1.3 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-trace-current, .ds-trace-ghost { display: block; width: 48px; height: 2px; background: var(--accent); } .ds-trace-ghost { border-top: 2px dashed var(--ghost); background: none; } .ds-trace b { font-weight: 400; }

narrative.overview: Ghostline is a compact downhill MTB telemetry workstation: matte green-black surfaces, fine instrument borders, condensed race-board headings, and measured data typography. Color is telemetry: acid yellow marks current state, pale green marks the ghost, and coral and mint report time lost and gained.

rules.name: The Telemetry Color Rule
rules.body: Use semantic state colors sparingly and consistently.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Compared numbers use IBM Plex Mono; prose stays in Barlow.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces or fine borders; do not add routine shadows.

dos: Do preserve the race-engineer workstation metaphor.
Do maintain visible focus and 40px targets.
donts: Don't introduce decorative gradients or routine shadows.
Don't use coral or mint as general brand accents.
Don't replace the condensed heading and mono measurement pairing.
